analysis: Template switches trigger click from toggle to open to avoid closing/reopening a select opened earlier in a focus handler.
open moves its _canOpen guard before measurement and modal ownership work; earlier valid-open operations stay in the same order.

close keeps stateChanges notification inside the actual-open branch; MDC form-field notification details belong to the current companion implementation, not a requirement to add modern host state changes to the historical control.

Owned open has an earlier lifetime/_canOpen guard and delegates public derived geometry only for a newly opened panel. Its explicit public toggle method remains intact; onContainerClick focuses then calls open. Focus-trigger click should be idempotent without requiring consumer HTML/CSS/SCSS changes. Actual artifact observations remain pending.
